steps.title: Walk to the Lumbridge general store. …
steps.text: Walk to the Lumbridge general store. — On the way, drop File:Bronze_axe.png axe, File:Tinderbox.png tinderbox, File:Small_fishing_net.png net, File:Shrimps.png shrimps, File:Bread.png bread, File:Pot.png pot, File:Bronze_arrow_5.png arrows, File:Earth_rune.png earth runes, File:Body_rune.png body runes. — Type ::toggleroofs into the chat box to toggle roofs (if necessary). — Sell: File:Bronze_dagger.png Dagger, File:Bronze_sword.png Sword, File:Wooden_shield.png Shield, File:Shortbow.png Bow — Buy: File:Spade.png Spade — {{Inventory |Coins\39 |Spade | | |Bronze pickaxe | | | | | |Air rune\25 |Mind rune\15 |Bucket | | |Water rune\6 | | | | | | | | | | | | }}

steps.title: Run to Veos in The Sheared …
steps.text: Run to Veos in The Sheared Ram to start X Marks the Spot.

steps.title: Pass through the Gate into Al …
steps.text: Pass through the Gate into Al Kharid, run to Chancellor Hassan to start Prince Ali Rescue.

steps.title: Run out of the palace, talk …
steps.text: Run out of the palace, talk to Osman.

steps.title: File:Spade.png Dig north of the house …
steps.text: File:Spade.png Dig north of the house connected to Bob's Axes for X Marks the Spot (north of the west window).

steps.title: File:Transportation_icon.png Talk to Count Check in …
steps.text: File:Transportation_icon.png Talk to Count Check in the graveyard to teleport to the Stronghold of Security.

steps.title: Enter the Stronghold of Security, complete …
steps.text: Enter the Stronghold of Security, complete only the first level, and claim the 2000 Coins. — Take the far north path. — The questions are randomized, but if you spam click the doors you will eventually get no question and be allowed straight through. — If you cannot claim the 2000 Coins, reread the top of this guide for info on how to enable Authenticator.

steps.title: File:Bank_icon.png Deposit all items except for …
steps.text: File:Bank_icon.png Deposit all items except for your spade at the Varrock west bank deposit box.

steps.title: Talk to Romeo to start Romeo …
steps.text: Talk to Romeo to start Romeo & Juliet.

steps.title: Talk to Juliet upstairs after running …
steps.text: Talk to Juliet upstairs after running west.
